item_short_desc: Griffin’s Scuff Cover is built for uniformed professionals who need fast, reliable results. This wax-based formula covers scuffs and marks while nourishing, shining, and adding water resistance to smooth leather. The built-in sponge applicator allows for quick, easy touch-ups, perfect for tactical boots, dress oxfords, duty shoes, and everyday footwear. Proudly crafted in the United States for superior quality and durability.
